midnightthoughts.sleep.nightmare_blocked: You cannot sleep in such a dreadful place...
midnightthoughts.summary.headline.self_m: Since last sleep you are MVP
midnightthoughts.achievement.mobs_record: Beat your personal mob kill record
option.midnightthoughts.mvp_well_rested_: Well Rested length for the MVP
option.midnightthoughts.enable_overlay.t: Turn the whole sleep overlay off and keep the vanilla screen.
option.midnightthoughts.enable_image.too: Shows the current moon phase above the text, or the skull during a nightmare.
option.midnightthoughts.enable_daily_sum: Opens the statistics screen after the night is skipped.
option.midnightthoughts.enable_star_dust: Small drifting specks of light behind the text. They keep clear of the moon and the text.
option.midnightthoughts.enable_space_obj: Distant planets and stars drawn behind the text. Larger ones fade more slowly and are rarer.
option.midnightthoughts.show_slide_progr: A thin bar under the text showing how long the current slide stays.
option.midnightthoughts.use_facts_api.to: Pulls extra facts from an online service. Off by default, since it needs a connection.
option.midnightthoughts.user_content_rep: On, your own slides are the only ones shown. Off, they are mixed in with the built-in ones.
option.midnightthoughts.hide_chat_when_s: Keeps the chat window out of the way while the overlay is up.
option.midnightthoughts.hide_hud_message: Hides titles and action bar text so nothing covers the slide.
option.midnightthoughts.min_slide_time.t: The shortest a single slide can stay on screen.
option.midnightthoughts.max_slide_time.t: The longest a single slide can stay on screen. Each slide picks a random time in between.
option.midnightthoughts.fade_in.tooltip: How long a new slide takes to appear.
option.midnightthoughts.fade_out.tooltip: How long the previous slide takes to disappear.
How strongly the world behind the overlay is dimmed.
option.midnightthoughts.text_opacity.too: How solid the slide text looks.
option.midnightthoughts.image_opacity.to: How solid the moon looks above the text.
option.midnightthoughts.text_scale.toolt: Scales the slide text. The mod still shrinks long texts to fit.
option.midnightthoughts.image_scale.tool: Scales the moon. The text below moves with it.
option.midnightthoughts.special_slide_ch: How often a rare slide is drawn instead of an ordinary one.
option.midnightthoughts.theme.tooltip: The look of the daily summary and the sleeping players HUD. On a server, the server's theme is used.
option.midnightthoughts.hud_position.too: Where the Well Rested indicator sits on screen.
option.midnightthoughts.hide_well_rested: Removes the Well Rested indicator entirely. The effect still works.
option.midnightthoughts.hide_sleeping_pl: Removes the list of players currently in bed.
option.midnightthoughts.mvp_enabled.tool: Picks the player with the highest score each night and gives them a longer Well Rested effect.
option.midnightthoughts.mvp_min_score.to: Below this score nobody becomes MVP, so a quiet day has no winner.
option.midnightthoughts.mvp_points_dista: Score earned for every 100 blocks travelled.
option.midnightthoughts.mvp_points_block: Score earned for every block mined.
option.midnightthoughts.mvp_points_mob.t: Score earned for every mob defeated.
option.midnightthoughts.mvp_death_penalt: Score lost for every death during the day.
option.midnightthoughts.mvp_well_rested_: How long the MVP keeps the Well Rested effect. Everyone else uses the level duration from the config file.
option.midnightthoughts.reset_phantom_ti: When the night is skipped, players who stayed awake also stop attracting phantoms.
option.midnightthoughts.suppress_vanilla: Hides the built-in "players sleeping" and "skipping night" lines, since the mod shows its own.
Scores the room around the bed and uses it for nightmares and sleep blocking.
option.midnightthoughts.comfort_scan_rad: How far around the bed blocks are counted. Larger values cost more on the server.
option.midnightthoughts.nightmare_enable: Lets an uncomfortable room turn the overlay into a nightmare instead of a quiet night.
option.midnightthoughts.nightmare_thresh: A comfort score at or below this value gives a nightmare instead of an ordinary night.
option.midnightthoughts.sleep_block_enab: Refuses sleep outright when the room scores badly enough.
option.midnightthoughts.sleep_block_thre: A comfort score at or below this value stops the player from getting into bed at all.
How much lanterns, candles and other light sources change the comfort score of a bedroom.
option.midnightthoughts.weight_carpet.to: How much carpets and rugs underfoot change the comfort score of a bedroom.
option.midnightthoughts.weight_furniture: How much chairs, tables and other furniture change the comfort score of a bedroom.
option.midnightthoughts.weight_decoratio: How much flowers, paintings and small decorations change the comfort score of a bedroom.
option.midnightthoughts.weight_structure: How much walls, floors and a proper roof change the comfort score of a bedroom.
option.midnightthoughts.weight_macabre.t: How much skulls, cobwebs and other grim decor change the comfort score of a bedroom.
option.midnightthoughts.weight_hostile.t: How much hostile mobs lurking nearby change the comfort score of a bedroom.
option.midnightthoughts.weight_dark.tool: How much unlit corners and darkness change the comfort score of a bedroom.
screen.midnightthoughts.config.note.well: Well Rested effects and attributes are edited in the config file.
screen.midnightthoughts.config.note.serv: On a server these settings come from the server's own config file.
